nodes.label: Value
nodes.law: Atoms, products, closed variants and explicit opaque handles retain representation and nominal identity.
nodes.gate: Representation and primitive numeric/host profiles remain independently specified.

nodes.label: Bind
nodes.law: Names resolve lexically to declaration identities; capture and fresh cells retain their meaning.
nodes.gate: Shadowing, package identity and mutable capture evidence must survive lowering.

nodes.label: Apply
nodes.law: Ordered arguments are evaluated once and invoked under an explicit callable contract.
nodes.gate: General call shapes, defaults, capture and effect evidence are not inferred from a lambda encoding.

nodes.label: Choose
nodes.law: Only selected work executes; structural tests are inert and captures commit atomically.
nodes.gate: Coverage and pure-guard checking must be demonstrated.

nodes.label: Perform
nodes.law: An owner handles an explicit state, host or scheduler request with declared authority.
nodes.gate: Local mutation, world authority and suspension require different operational profiles.

nodes.label: Scope
nodes.law: A specified boundary owns completion, cleanup and child lifetime.
nodes.gate: Function, loop, resource and task policies cannot share an unspecified handler law.

nodes.label: Scalars, products and variants
nodes.law: Value constructors retain exact representations; Bool and Int are distinct.
nodes.gate: Portable wire, capacity and non-first-product scalar laws remain incomplete.

nodes.label: Bindings, imports and irrefutable destructuring
nodes.law: Evaluate once, tentatively bind, check and commit all names or none.
nodes.gate: Resolved identities and source-derived type/constraint evidence need target conformance.

nodes.label: Return, loop transfer, panic and cancellation
nodes.law: Normal value, function return, loop transfer, panic and cancellation retain distinct targets and causes.
nodes.gate: General multi-cause envelopes and cancellation during release remain open.

nodes.label: Types, constraints and evidence
nodes.law: A declared promise is checked; satisfied, refuted and unknown evidence remain distinct.
nodes.gate: Full inference and proof rules are not established by a codec or supplied annotation.

nodes.label: Closures and ordinary functions
nodes.law: Immutable captures have value semantics; mutable captures retain shared cell identity.
nodes.gate: General generic, capture, region and callback-effect contracts remain designing.

nodes.label: Nominal products and closed alternatives
nodes.law: Construction checks all fields and declaration invariants before publishing one owned value.
nodes.gate: Source-derived constructors and codecs need independent target agreement.

nodes.label: Bool choice and short circuit
nodes.law: Conditions require Bool; unselected expressions are never evaluated.
nodes.gate: Typed source lowering and exact event traces must agree.

nodes.label: Exhaustive structural matching
nodes.law: Shape failure and guard rejection discard tentative captures; every match is exhaustive.
nodes.gate: Coverage, guard purity and formatter/diagnostic conformance remain required.

nodes.label: Visible local state update
nodes.law: Validate the replacement before owner-controlled atomic cell publication.
nodes.gate: Captured-cell and invalid-update traces must agree across backends.

nodes.label: For/while and loop boundaries
nodes.law: Iteration order and nearest lexical break/continue targets remain observable.
nodes.gate: Recursion alone does not prove bounded stack, progress or iterator cleanup.

nodes.label: Option and Result
nodes.law: Absence and expected rejection are ordinary distinct closed carriers.
nodes.gate: Target nominal carriers cannot be inferred from host None or exceptions.

nodes.label: Postfix propagation
nodes.law: Inspect once; success extracts, rejection returns to the nearest compatible function.
nodes.gate: Error mapping is explicit; pending cleanup still precedes observation.

nodes.label: Safe navigation and fallback
nodes.law: Evaluate receiver once and evaluate only the selected fallback/property.
nodes.gate: Nested Option shape and effectful receiver traces require conformance.

nodes.label: First-argument pipeline insertion
nodes.law: Insert one evaluated value at the first argument position; preserve call order.
nodes.gate: Do not infer laziness, concurrency, currying or propagation.

nodes.label: Text interpolation and display
nodes.law: Evaluate embedded expressions once in order; display is a distinct protocol from encoding.
nodes.gate: General display/protocol and secret-redaction contracts remain open.

nodes.label: Parameter and field defaults
nodes.law: Evaluate each omitted default at the specified call/construction phase and retain provenance.
nodes.gate: A supplied value and an equal default value need distinct provenance.

nodes.label: Strict accumulated decoding
nodes.law: Validate received structure before owned construction; preserve independent original error paths.
nodes.gate: Custom field rules, budgets and non-projectable predicates need source-derived evidence.

nodes.label: Explicit encoding and schema projection
nodes.law: Encoding follows owned declarations; schema export reports omitted or approximate constraints.
nodes.gate: Human display and private engine transport cannot define the external format.

nodes.label: Progressive checking policies
nodes.law: A policy selects required evidence without changing successful meaning or granting authority.
nodes.gate: General public inference and dependency invalidation remain incomplete.

nodes.label: Explicit generic interface quantification
nodes.law: A generic contract names quantification, variance, constraints, captures and effects.
nodes.gate: One concrete call does not establish generality; source syntax and solver remain open.

nodes.label: Protocols, methods and dispatch
nodes.law: Operation selection is explicit/coherent within its declared package and import context.
nodes.gate: Collision, variance, specialization and extension visibility need a bounded comparison.

nodes.label: Numbers, units and tensor shapes
nodes.law: Numeric domain profiles own exactness, rounding, dimensions, axes and failures.
nodes.gate: No host numeric default or shared method name establishes common laws.

nodes.label: Strict collection verbs
nodes.law: Callbacks run in declared order and multiplicity; Result elements do not auto-propagate.
nodes.gate: General pure/effect-polymorphic, retaining and failure callback contracts remain open.

nodes.label: Effect contracts and runtime grants
nodes.law: Static effect evidence and unforgeable current runtime authority are separate facts.
nodes.gate: Grant delegation/revocation and host substitution require executable contracts.

nodes.label: Exactly-once resource scopes and defer
nodes.law: Acquire/body/release phases retain every completion cause; defer cleanup is lexical LIFO.
nodes.gate: General release-error carrier, non-escape and asynchronous release remain designing.

nodes.label: Cold async descriptions and explicit await
nodes.law: Constructing a cold task does not start it; await names suspension and outcome ownership.
nodes.gate: Scheduler transitions, cancellation and latent effects require conformance.

nodes.label: Owned concurrent children
nodes.law: Children cannot silently escape their group; completion waits for owned cleanup and children.
nodes.gate: Failure envelope, observation order, running and queue bounds remain open.

nodes.label: Streams and generators
nodes.law: Demand, consumption multiplicity, backpressure and release are explicit carrier laws.
nodes.gate: No generator source spelling or universal map schedule is admitted.

nodes.label: Retry and backoff
nodes.law: Invoke a fresh explicit attempt under policy; previous external effects are not undone.
nodes.gate: Idempotency, uncertainty and cancellation belong to the operation and host.

nodes.label: Channels, locks, atomics and actors
nodes.law: Publication visibility and ownership follow the selected synchronization protocol.
nodes.gate: A task group or mutable cell does not imply a memory model or delivery guarantee.

nodes.label: Closed checked module interfaces
nodes.law: Public identity, types, effects and dependencies are available without executing private code.
nodes.gate: Source-derived closed reuse and unknown-dependency refusal still need completion.

nodes.label: Content-addressed packages and builds
nodes.law: Source, lockfile, toolchain, target and declared inputs determine a sandboxed build.
nodes.gate: Resolver, trust, edition migration and deployment receipts remain incomplete.

nodes.label: FFI and explicit host adapters
nodes.law: ABI, copying/borrowing, affinity, blocking and host failures are declared at the boundary.
nodes.gate: A host value is not nominal proof; portable ABI and ownership fixtures remain open.

nodes.label: Secrets and redacted observation
nodes.law: Secret projection is redacted by default; reveal requires explicit audited authority.
nodes.gate: Redaction across display, paths, logs and crash records requires conformance.

nodes.label: Diagnostics, traces and explanation
nodes.law: A claim names its source, dependencies, phase, coverage and unresolved facts.
nodes.gate: A friendly view must not upgrade evidence or expose secret payloads.

nodes.label: Examples, checks and test harnesses
nodes.law: Independent expectations, compared values and replaced host capabilities retain context.
nodes.gate: Passing examples do not prove all-input equivalence or backend conformance.

nodes.label: Engine-free references and descriptions
nodes.law: Typed references, inert operation descriptions and closed definitions exist without an executor.
nodes.gate: The lab envelope has no control-flow, effectful execution or universal domain algebra.

nodes.label: Engine-free refinement obligations
nodes.law: Literal and explicit input evidence discharge closed relations and finite universal unary conditions; computed operands stay pending and empty universals are vacuous.
nodes.gate: Nested/correlated quantification and scientific assumptions require further laws; condition-only inputs require explicit inclusion.

nodes.label: Explicit compilation, binding and realization
nodes.law: Choose a pinned implementation, check capability/preconditions, then execute detached bound values.
nodes.gate: Trusted callbacks and cooperative cancellation are bounded lab evidence, not formal conformance.

nodes.label: Declared expansion and independent replay
nodes.law: Replay uses context-bound rules and preserves source identity; unsupported equality is unknown.
nodes.gate: Formal domain equality needs an admitted theory, side conditions and independent consumers.

nodes.label: Document specifications and rendering
nodes.law: Meaning and publication conditions are separate from renderer choice and Text conversion.
nodes.gate: Two local profiles do not establish remote rendering, review or file publication.

nodes.label: Schema-bound relational plans
nodes.law: Schema, grain, nullability, order and cardinality belong to the table carrier.
nodes.gate: Strict callbacks cannot be retagged as row expressions; adapters need pinned table laws.

nodes.label: Statistical summaries and exact laws
nodes.law: Observation domains, shared masks and numeric theory qualify sum/count/division identities.
nodes.gate: Empty samples, missingness, units and physical engines need independent domain evidence.

nodes.label: Training, prediction and evaluation
nodes.law: Train-only learned state and evaluation split identities remain separate from predictions.
nodes.gate: Adaptive evaluation, uncertainty and deletion/unlearning are unresolved domain contracts.

nodes.label: Reactive, incremental and temporal models
nodes.law: Every change has a model/revision/time basis and an explicit invalidation/publication policy.
nodes.gate: Caching, snapshots, live adoption and physical time are distinct choices.

nodes.label: Symbolic quotation, rewriting and staging
nodes.law: A quoted model retains stage, hygiene, effects, provenance and bounded transformations.
nodes.gate: No global macros or ambient compile-time execution is admitted.

nodes.label: Scoped query, tensor, grammar and template notation
nodes.law: An explicitly entered scope has declared input/output meaning and inspectable expansion.
nodes.gate: Every notation needs its own parser, diagnostics, laws and whole-activity evidence.

nodes.label: Local transactions and owner commit
nodes.law: The actual owner defines atomicity, isolation, revision validation and visible publication.
nodes.gate: Pure candidate validation is not serializable publication or a distributed transaction.

nodes.label: Delivery, outbox and reconciliation
nodes.law: Delivery identity, processing ownership, settlement and uncertain external outcomes remain distinct.
nodes.gate: Broker profiles and crash/recovery traces are required; retries do not ensure exactly-once effects.

nodes.label: Durable workflows and orchestration
nodes.law: Dependency, attempt, partition and idempotency identities survive recovery and handoff.
nodes.gate: Persistence, compensation, grant freshness and unknown outcomes need real adapters.

nodes.label: Reviewed semantic edits and commands
nodes.law: A proposal names its intent, target revision and review scope; commit checks current authority.
nodes.gate: No UI token or validated candidate can stand in for owner-enforced commit.

nodes.label: Views, visualizations and inverse edits
nodes.law: A projection states its model basis, losses and editable inverse obligations.
nodes.gate: Human comprehension, accessibility and inverse-law comparisons remain unvalidated.

nodes.label: Drafts, holes and last-good states
nodes.law: An incomplete draft and recovery guess retain their status rather than manufacturing a valid program.
nodes.gate: Supported-hole semantics and safe partial execution need a distinct admission.

nodes.label: Natural-language and automated proposals
nodes.law: Inference, checked meaning, reviewed intent, authority and external observation are separate evidence.
nodes.gate: Actual role validation, calibrated reliance and interrupted recovery need human and host evidence.

nodes.label: The first coherent report activity
nodes.law: Decode every row before eligibility filtering; preserve order/duplicates and explicit error mapping.
nodes.gate: Current compatibility delivery is not target data/call/Result/reuse conformance.

nodes.label: Cross-domain creative and shared activity
nodes.law: Meaning, representations, evidence, authority and revision remain recoverable across one activity.
nodes.gate: A dependency map is not a demonstrated coherent computational medium.

nodes.label: Reusable multi-output graph workflows
nodes.law: Reference parameters substitute explicitly; namespaced intermediates and carried conditions retain graph-qualified identity.
nodes.gate: Independent pinned substitution runs; broader interfaces, operational scopes and authoring/repair benefits need comparison.
